part.text:
Implemented `std::filesystem::path` presentation types in `include/fmt/std.h`.

- `{:n}` explicitly formats using `path::native()` (same as default).
- `{:g}` formats using `path::generic_string()`, yielding slash-separated paths on Windows.
- Debug formatting also respects `:g`.
- Existing width and debug parsing remain supported.

Validation completed in the provided container:

```sh
cmake --build build --target std-test -j2
./build/bin/std-test
```

All 13 `std-test` tests passed. `git diff --check` also passed.
